hypothesis: H1 (scoring protocol synthetic suite) and H5 step 5 (candidate choice)
ruling: Eleonora, 22 October 2026, PR #1137 (comment 6354246426): answers 1, 2, 3 and 5 at their defaults; answer 4 decided by this simulation

strict.note: a tie with a quantile is a miss

tie_counts.note: a tie with a quantile is a hit

randomised.note: a tie is a hit with the probability the forecast's own distribution gives it

variants_note: three hit rules compared on one set of paths, all three reported in every table; no model variant is added

amendments.what: added the variants block and its note, which the #803 rule (tests/test_model_declarations.py) asks of a declaration under metadata/
amendments.effect: no design, world, seed or factor changed; the figures are re-run unchanged and the record carries the new hash

design.randomised_tie_probability: coverage_tests.tie_hit_probability from the forecast's own discrete distribution
design.flag: scoring_protocol.COVERAGE_REQUIREMENT_IN_FORCE is patched True inside the script only; it is never set in the tree

world.target: round(x_t) in whole bp, x_t = mu_r + a (x_{t-1} - mu_r) + e_t, e_t ~ N(0, s_r^2); the forecaster knows x_t, the regime schedule and the law, so it is calibrated by construction
world.forecast_quantiles: the integer quantile of the forecast's own discretised normal: the smallest integer k with P(Y <= k) >= level, so outcomes tie it

size.path_seed: base_seed * 100000 + path index; the world, then the randomised draws, from random.Random(path_seed) and random.Random(path_seed + 50000)

power.forecaster: too narrow: the same law with its standard deviation multiplied by the factor, quantiles and tie probabilities from the narrowed law, outcomes from the true law
power.only_for: each rule whose family-wise size is at most 0.05
power.note: the factors are this declaration's choice; #961's narrow forecaster is not on main, so its width is not reproduced

interval: Wilson 95% interval on the share of paths that fail
pass_rule: a rule is named when the calibrated forecaster fails the family-wise requirement on no more than 0.05 of the paths (point estimate); if none does, none is named; if several do, all are named and none is chosen
